comment: Irreducible imagemap (cmapx/imap) divergences (mission: map-conformance, AD-7 twin of accepted-divergences-xdot.json). Each entry: {id, opClass, delta, rationale}. The walker treats listed ids as non-blocking ('accepted') for BOTH formats and continues. Every entry MUST be referenced in the decision journal with its mechanism. Empty at initial survey time — this is the first triage pass; fixes and any resulting acceptances are a follow-up mission. Class acceptance (added 2026-07-29): the A1-drift roster for the iterative engines is COMPUTED from attribution-<engine>.json's drift-exonerated verdicts via `classes` + test/corpus/accepted-class.ts, mirroring what parity-report.ts already does for the xdot tracks — a hand-enumerated roster of a growing set went stale on the 2026-07-27 corpus expansion. Per-id `divergences` rows still apply and are unioned with the class. Fault acceptance (added 2026-10-14): an entry with { verdict: 'port-error' | 'timeout', errIncludes } accepts a matching port failure instead of a divergence (the row becomes 'accepted' with its errMsg kept; plans/registry-faults-staleness/decisions.md AD-1).

divergences.rationale: A8 rounding-boundary dust: 1 of 272 hotspot coords sits within the sub-0.01pt model tolerance of the integer rounding boundary (port 2654.5x vs native 2654.4x -> 2655 vs 2654); osage xdot track passes at 0.01. Irreducible print amplification. Journal 2026-07-24.

A10: faithful pack.c int step/placement arithmetic (97fcccd8) needs 2,011,656,764 PointSet cells for this 3e16pt-tall node (native 16.1.0 completes in 482 s at 67.3 GB resident); the port's PointSet is a V8 Map capped at 2^24 entries, so the render throws. A runtime limit below the code, not a logic gap; accepted as a port-error row (verdict/errIncludes). Evidence: comparisons/2784-pack-cells.md.
